QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] Love, an Incurable Disease
QuestInfo.0: After calming down, Francis tells you how he fell in love with Orchid, even though you totally don't care.
QuestInfo.1: The fact that Francis is excited about telling you a story you don't care about is... simply sad.
QuestInfo.2: He told you the story because he has another request for you. He's pretty sneaky.
